name: ember-linking-backend
description: Holds the aggregator credentials so the browser never has to.

scripts.//build: There is nothing to build — Wrangler bundles src/worker.js itself. This exists because Cloudflare's build setup prefills `npm run build`, and a missing script fails the deploy with an error about package.json rather than about the thing that is actually wrong.
scripts.build: node -e "console.log('No build step: wrangler bundles src/worker.js at deploy time.')"
